changes.effect: download robustness only; does not change decoded mid scale, range checks, bar aggregation, carry differentials, spreads, slippage, rollover, or the Demo rule
checks the original frozen/v7.json hash from frozen/v7.sha256, then checks the runnable set against frozen/v7.1.sha256

note: Download-only patch. frozen/v7.json (signals, costs, basket, eval/Demo gates, trial count) is byte-identical to the original freeze. lib/v7.aura, v7-paper.aura, v7-monitor.aura, scripts/v7-market.py, scripts/v7-book.py, scripts/v7-eval.py, and scripts/v7-freeze.py are also unchanged.
prior-quiet-hash-updates: f052ca7 and 1fb69e0 overwrote the fetch.py line inside frozen/v7.sha256 in place. That was a silent change to the freeze record. This patch restores frozen/v7.sha256 to the exact 29dd074 bytes and records the runnable hashes in frozen/v7.1.sha256 instead.
why: f052ca7: scripts/v7-fetch.py could not parse. An unused variable was removed and the H1 write loop was left over-indented. The first post-freeze run failed at import, before any v7 basket download or official booking.

1fb69e0: Dukascopy had not published the current UTC month (2026-11 returned HTTP 404). The original fetcher used curl -f and retried 30 times, then aborted. The patch records the HTTP status, uses HTTP/1.1, and skips only the current unpublished month; any historical 404 still fails hard.
